pieces.Text: You can always move at full speed while using Survival to follow tracks without penalty. You can, as a standard action, make a single attack against a favored enemy at your full attack bonus. If the attack hits, the target takes damage normally and must make a Fortitude save or die (DC

). You can choose instead to deal an amount of nonlethal damage equal to the creature's current hit points. A successful save negates this damage. You can use this ability once per day against each favored enemy type you possess, but not against the same creature more than once in a 24-hour period.
